strings.en:
{1c:16}{0b:08}【 Qumran 】{0b:09}
That... I cannot answer with certainty.{1a}It may be that several unfortunate
coincidences piled up and threw a switch.{1a}It is also possible that the mass
emergence of monsters was an
unchangeable 'future', fixed ten
thousand years ago.{1a}I do not say this merely to set your
minds at ease.{1a}The interval between the first outbreak
of monsters and the second was written
on a certain tablet.{1a}Yes, just as if it had foretold these
events ten thousand years in advance...{1a}In that case, you would be victims
caught up in a fate decreed ten
thousand years ago.{1a}Regrettably, however, at this point I also
cannot say for certain that the 'Pillar
of Sheol' has nothing to do with the
monsters' appearance.{1a}And sadly, it is also the plain truth that
the numbers have grown sharply with
each outbreak: the first, the second,
the third.{0c:fe}
